review.why: Tears down competitors' paid ads from public ad libraries: hooks, formats, landing pages, gaps and counter-plays.
review.summary: Collects ads from the Meta Ad Library and Google Ads Transparency Center through search and page fetches, clusters hooks and formats, analyzes the landing pages and message match, groups ads into campaigns, infers where spend goes, and ends with a report of creative gaps, vulnerabilities and proposed counter-plays.
strengths: Uses ad longevity as a signal of what converts
Full report layout from coverage to counter-plays
No API key or paid service needed
cautions: Search results may expose few ads; the skill itself says scrapers are unreliable
Spend shares inferred from ad counts are rough estimates
Covers paid ads only, not organic or SEO work
